segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so quick update on Finch Manufacturing. They're at 68 seats, annual services bundle, $54,720 net, and they want a March 18 go-live.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay, that all sounds normal. What's still open before they can get it done?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: I've pinged legal twice on their indemnity redline; procurement said they won't countersign until that note comes back.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Got it. Any product or security questions still floating around?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Just the retention table. I nudged the security team again this morning, because their IT lead is holding the PO until we answer the 18-month log question.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. And price-wise, are they okay with the seat minimum and the services line?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, price is fine. Only thing on commercial is deal desk hasn't approved the 24-month ramp; I asked them yesterday and again before this call, and I can't send the final quote until that sign-off lands.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Alright. Keep Finch warm with the March 18 plan and tell them we're cleaning up the last internal items. If you get answers by Friday morning, we can still close it this month.
